        Description copied from interface: PublicationReceiverFacade
        Starts an update process on the remote side. To clean up resources, either #commitUpdate(UpdateInfo, String, Set, Stream, ExceptionThrowingRunnable) or PublicationReceiverFacade.abortUpdate(UpdateInfo) must be called afterwards.
        Specified by:
        startUpdate in interface PublicationReceiverFacade
        Parameters:
        replicationPaths - information about the release root, source and target paths during replication. The ReplicationPaths.getContentPath() can contain the root content path that should be considered, if it is only a subpath of the ReplicationPaths.getOrigin().
        Returns:
        the basic information about the update which must be used for all related calls on this update.
        Throws:
        ReplicationException
